programme.title: REV
programme.desc: The Zaporozhets has become a symbol of Ukrainian identity and resistance to the Russian invasion. Produced in Ukraine during Soviet times, the Zapo walks a tightrope between East and West, war and peace. Intended as a VW Beetle for Siberian farmers, the Zapo has found fans all over the world. From Putin’s first ride to Monte Carlo Rallies during wartime — this is the story of a car that won’t quit
programme.sub-title: The Zaporozhets: Ukraine's forgotten car giant

programme.title: Euromaxx
programme.desc: What's everyday life like for a young Venetian, how can you give your pet a dignified farewell, and how did Berlin-style pork knuckle get its name?

programme.title: Russian Laundering
programme.desc: “Money mules” are people lured on the Internet and forced to launder money for hacker gangs and organized crime. Apparently serious jobs offers which become a nightmare. The documentary follows the money flow from Switzerland to Russia.

programme.title: Angel of Nanjing
programme.desc: The Yangtze River Bridge in Nanjing is the most popular place in the world to commit suicide, with over 5 attempts per week. For the past 11 years, blue-collar worker Chen Si has been patrolling this bridge every day, watching out for desperate people who've gone there to end their lives. With no formal training, he has saved over 300 people since he began; earning him the nickname the 'Angel of Nanjing'.

programme.title: Where to Miss
programme.desc: In the sprawling, noisy madness of Delhi, Devki battles to achieve her dream - to become a taxi driver. The odds are stacked against her; the dangers, her sex and the deeply rooted traditions of Indian society. In this crafted and riveting doc we witness Devki's battle to accomplish her dreams. Within a city shaken by the bus rape of 2012, Devki strives to have the best that life can offer her. Her journey is anything but smooth.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Islam has 1.6 billion followers around the world - so perhaps it's where host Tevya will find the answer's he's looking for. He starts out with a visit to the Taric Islamic Centre where he learns why it is important to cleanse himself before prayer, what Halal is, an introduction to the history of Muhammad and the devotion it takes to be a Muslim.

programme.title: Only Water in the Sea
programme.desc: There is not much fish left in the Mediterranean Sea, and both fishermen and dolphins are fighting for surviving. This film shows the consequences of overfishing and unsustainable tourism in the island of Stromboli through two of the last guardians of a world that is disappearing. This is a story of extinctions of fish population and local traditions. But there is hope for the next generations.

programme.title: Apollo 8 Christmas At The Moon
programme.desc: This one hour documentary profiles the first manned Mission to the Moon, and includes interviews with the astronauts and many of the NASA officials who were a part of this historic event.

programme.title: Origin of the Species
programme.desc: Abigail Child has been at the vanguard of experimental media since the 1980s. In her latest project, she offers viewers an eerie look into the present and future of AI, through the perspectives of scientists, entrepreneurs and a Black lesbian robot. Child’s thought-provoking film considers the emerging technology’s ethical and emotional implications, presenting a speculative, not-too-distant future grounded in sci-fi.

programme.title: The Neutral Ground
programme.desc: In 2015, CJ Hunt was filming the New Orleans City Council’s vote to remove four confederate monuments from the city. A forceful group of critics protested the decision and fearing retaliation, no crew would agree to remove the statues. CJ sets out to understand why a losing army from 1865 still holds so much power in America. At once funny and furious, this film documents the USA's troubled romance with the Lost Cause.

programme.desc: There is not much fish left in the Mediterranean Sea, and both fishermen and dolphins are fighting for surviving. This film shows the consequences of overfishing and unsustainable tourism in the island of Stromboli through two of the last guardians of a world that is disappearing. This is a story of extinctions of fish population and local traditions. But there is hope for the next generations.

programme.title: Apollo 8 Christmas At The Moon
programme.desc: This one hour documentary profiles the first manned Mission to the Moon, and includes interviews with the astronauts and many of the NASA officials who were a part of this historic event.

programme.title: Origin of the Species
programme.desc: Abigail Child has been at the vanguard of experimental media since the 1980s. In her latest project, she offers viewers an eerie look into the present and future of AI, through the perspectives of scientists, entrepreneurs and a Black lesbian robot. Child’s thought-provoking film considers the emerging technology’s ethical and emotional implications, presenting a speculative, not-too-distant future grounded in sci-fi.

programme.title: The Neutral Ground
programme.desc: In 2015, CJ Hunt was filming the New Orleans City Council’s vote to remove four confederate monuments from the city. A forceful group of critics protested the decision and fearing retaliation, no crew would agree to remove the statues. CJ sets out to understand why a losing army from 1865 still holds so much power in America. At once funny and furious, this film documents the USA's troubled romance with the Lost Cause.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Could the best kind of belief possibly be, no belief at all? Host Tevya decides to check out atheism. As the program begins he finds himself in a graveyard, where he is visited by an important insight ... "being dead sucks!" Later in the program, he meets the president of Canada's Freethought Association, which stirs up a little controversy with it's provocative ad slogan "There's probably no God. So stop worrying and enjoy life". Finally, he finds himself immersed in God.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

programme.title: War Peace
programme.desc: War/Peace documentary film is re-introducing the radical student activists from the late 60s. Ex-leaders of The Weather Underground movement Bill Ayers and Bernardine Dohrn. For decades the government and press have tried their best to silence them. This film will serve as an historical reminder of what happened the last time a group of young minds planned to take over an unpopular government in Washington.

programme.title: The Great Awakening: QAnon
programme.desc: The far-right political movement known as QAnon has taken off around the world, mobilising a committed band of believers dedicated to fighting what they claim is an ‘online war’ against corrupt, child abusing elites. In the United States, the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has declared QAnon a potential domestic terrorism threat. For one family, QAnon has caused division so severe that they had to report their relative - Tim Stewart, a QAnon conspiracy theorist - to Australia's national security hotline. In a concerning twist, it emerged that Stewart has had a longstanding friendship with Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison - leading to speculation about QAnon and Australia's highest ranks of political power. A look at the alarming movement which has caused ripples through the world, through the eyes of one family.

programme.title: Unknown Distance
programme.desc: After five tours and ten years as a Marine Sniper, Sergeant Douglas Brown, alongside director and producer Gordon Clark, takes us on an emotional journey across America, documenting the powerful testimony of returning combat veterans - all trained with a deadly skill set, now rendered useless. How do these soldiers fit back into a society that supported them when they enlisted but became ambivalent when they returned?

programme.title: Mariupol: The Chronicles of Hell
programme.desc: Mariupol - ruined but not conquered. The city in the east of Ukraine has survived the occupation, total destruction, and a humanitarian catastrophe. The story of Mariupol is an especially horrifying one, with accounts reported that occupiers were murdering civilians, and actively preventing them from escaping. This film is the story of the survivors, and their life in a hell on Earth. Yet it's also a testament to the power of resilience, and Ukrainian fighting spirit.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: While many mainline Christian churches are in decline, Evangelical Christianity remains a powerful force in the 21st century. With 2.1 billion followers worldwide, this particular branch of faith must be doing something right. In this program, host Tevya enters the world of Evangelicals, meeting a local pastor whose weekly service is broadcast to five different locations and features a full rockband. He learns that it is all about giving back.

programme.title: Cosmic
programme.desc: In the wake of COVID19, students, doctors, and engineers from all around BC, Canada, formed an Open Source community to design innovative PPE devices and limit the spread of the virus.

programme.title: Outbreak Onboard
programme.desc: Cruise ships gave coronavirus a free ride around the world this Spring. While infected passengers think the Ruby Princess should be sailed out to sea and sunk, its owner company is busy marketing post-Covid cruises. Far from protecting people, the release of the ship’s passengers onto Australian shores triggered a public health emergency with the Ruby Princess now named as the single largest source of Australia’s coronavirus infections. Tracey Temple, a passenger with underlying health conditions, is adamant that Princess Cruises forewent their duty of care. “As far as I’m concerned, they never put our safety first”. Pleas for information were met with reassurance from staff that “this ship is virus free”. The cruise liner was ultimately called back to Sydney, but not before the virus had spread unchecked among the passengers, and unchallenged by social distancing measures. Unaware of the public health disaster they were carrying, the passengers then dissipated not only across Australia, but the world. “We thought we were going into the problem; we didn’t realise we were the problem,” says another passenger. 850 passengers and crew from the ship contracted the virus,and at least 26 died.

programme.title: Finding Freedom
programme.desc: Finding Freedom is a feature length documentary that explores rehabilitation through the stories of Franklin and Malcolm, who after being released from South Africa’s notorious prison system, work to redefine the freedom that comes with life after a life sentence.

programme.title: Good old Czechs
programme.desc: During World War Two, Czechoslovakian airmen fought across the world. Defending the Allied Power's skies, they even played an integral role in the Battle of Britain. This is the story of two Czech men who served in Britain's RAF - yet on return to their home country, a hero's welcome merges into persecution, as the communist party seizes power. A timeless and poignant recounting of young lives sacrificed in wartime.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: With more than 300 million followers worldwide, Buddhists follow a path towards enlightenment in what is as much a religion, as it is a way of life. A Buddhist Monk attempts to quieten host Tevya's mind, but first - a celebration. It's Buddha's birthday and Tevya is in for a food-fight while meeting "The Hungry Ghosts".

programme.title: True or False
programme.desc: It is the most serious scandal ever hitting the modern art market. An affair that has made experts and auction houses tremble and has re-proposed the ghost of forgery. The facts date back to 2017 in Genoa, where an exhibition dedicated to the painter Amedeo Modigliani from Livorno was closed by the Public Prosecutor’s Office, which put 21 paintings out of the 60 on display under seizure.

programme.title: Killing Field
programme.desc: For years, allegations of war crimes have swirled around Australia’s special forces in Afghanistan. Australian prosecutors have been investigating a small group of elite special forces who stand accused of committing and covering up the murder of civilians in Afghanistan. With exclusive footage and testimony from a former special forces operative, this documentary reveals a shocking culture of murder and impunity.

programme.title: Our Days
programme.desc: On a journey through the corners of large cities such as Milan, Napoli or Venice, and small towns such as Erice or Matera, the gaze stops at the privacy of family industries, luxury crafts, shops, cooperatives and recovered factories; in the one-on-one encounter of women and men who work, with the matter they transform. With the portrait of that magical and ancestral moment that gives rise to something new, the devotion and agony of working class that loves, suffers and continues to fight its interwoven.

programme.title: Sidik and the Panther
programme.desc: Sidik has spent the last twenty-five years searching for a Persian leopard in the genocide-scarred mountains of Kurdistan in northern Iraq. If he can capture one of these magical creatures on film, the rugged region will be declared a national park and the bombs will never fall again. Acclaimed director Reber Dosky guides us through the Kurdish mountains alongside Sidik, in this beautiful and inspiring visual ode to perseverance and peaceful patriotism.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Host Tevya begins his spiritual quest by investigating Hinduism, a faith with some 900 million followers worldwide. programme.title: Close your eyes and Fly
programme.desc: The whole world thought it was impossible — that blind people could fly aeroplanes. Sabrina is a blind woman from birth who, with great tenacity, has learned to fly.

programme.title: Kabul, Just Before Darkness
programme.desc: A Swiss Italian television crew was in Kabul in the days leading up to the surrender and was able to document the growing anguish of a society that feels the end of a hope cultivated for twenty years. programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Do real life witches ride broomsticks and cast magic spells? Host Tevya talks to plants, tries a love potion and befriends some teenage witches in the magical world of Wicca. But, when the high priestess, Greymoon, directs Tevya to take a ritualistic bath as part of a welcoming rite, our spiritual explorer finds himself a little outside his comfort zone.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. Emei Mountain is a religious center for many sects of Chinese Buddhism. Long ago, it was the battleground where Buddhism clashed with one of China's leading religious at that time, Taoism.

programme.title: Ghost Mountain
programme.desc: After the Cambodian genocide in the Killing Fields, Bunseng’s family tried to flee, but ended up in an even more life-threatening situation. Without the tireless efforts of Non-Governmental Organisations and Government officials, who saved them in dramatic conditions, they would have been forgotten, like the millions of Cambodians who died. Decades later, while working - painting the home of a rescuer - Bunseng discovered the hero he never knew.

programme.title: Milan, Everyone At Home
programme.desc: It’s a hot Sunday in March in Milan, when Claudio Rizzotti, freelance filmmaker, decides to take his camera to document what is beginning to happen around him. It is the beginning of the Italian lockdown for the Covid 19 pandemic and so his city, his friends and his family sink into a long lethargy.

programme.title: I Am Miriam Bin Laden
programme.desc: Mariam Bin Laden is going to swim across the English Channel. This represents not only an athletic challenge, but a symbolic and ardent dream: to give a second chance to her family, to inspire and empower Arab women to go after their dreams, as well as promote awareness for one of the most important issues of our time, refugees in dire need who are forced everyday to cross boundaries to survive.

programme.title: Made in China
programme.desc:
The celebration of the Chinese New Year is coming and Yu Liang Yuan (21 years old) starts his journey from the industrial colony where he resides in Shenzhen to his birthplace in Henan (inland of the Asiatic giant). But these aren't any regular holidays. his year, his visit is crucial for his future and that of his family. He hopes to get engaged with an old schoolmate whom he's been dating.
What nobody could actually foresee, is that she and her family have been looking for other candidates and have decided that Yu Liang Yuan's family is not rich enough to accept their marriage proposal.
This unexpected turn of events will force him to start questioning the world around him and the need to follow a set of rules and traditions which he doesn't really share. Forcing him to face who he is and what he truly wants.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Continuing his quest for belief, host Tevya get's a fresh look at the history and traditions of the Hasidic Jews (a little different to the Judaism he was used to). Rabbi Kaplan and some new friends offer insight into the most important passage in a Jewish boy's life, the Bar Mitzvah, celebrate Purim and have dinner with the Rabbi's family. Can Rabbi Kaplan reveal the answer to one of the burning questions - why can't Jews eat bacon?

programme.title: In the Starlight
programme.desc: In the Starlight is an intimate portrayal about the life of nature photographer Paul Zizka and his quest to capture the night skies.

programme.title: Russian Laundering
programme.desc: “Money mules” are people lured on the Internet and forced to launder money for hacker gangs and organized crime. Apparently serious jobs offers which become a nightmare. The documentary follows the money flow from Switzerland to Russia.

programme.title: Angel of Nanjing
programme.desc: The Yangtze River Bridge in Nanjing is the most popular place in the world to commit suicide, with over 5 attempts per week. For the past 11 years, blue-collar worker Chen Si has been patrolling this bridge every day, watching out for desperate people who've gone there to end their lives. With no formal training, he has saved over 300 people since he began; earning him the nickname the 'Angel of Nanjing'.

programme.title: Where to Miss
programme.desc: In the sprawling, noisy madness of Delhi, Devki battles to achieve her dream - to become a taxi driver. The odds are stacked against her; the dangers, her sex and the deeply rooted traditions of Indian society. In this crafted and riveting doc we witness Devki's battle to accomplish her dreams. Within a city shaken by the bus rape of 2012, Devki strives to have the best that life can offer her. Her journey is anything but smooth.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Islam has 1.6 billion followers around the world - so perhaps it's where host Tevya will find the answer's he's looking for. He starts out with a visit to the Taric Islamic Centre where he learns why it is important to cleanse himself before prayer, what Halal is, an introduction to the history of Muhammad and the devotion it takes to be a Muslim.

programme.title: Only Water in the Sea
programme.desc: There is not much fish left in the Mediterranean Sea, and both fishermen and dolphins are fighting for surviving. This film shows the consequences of overfishing and unsustainable tourism in the island of Stromboli through two of the last guardians of a world that is disappearing. This is a story of extinctions of fish population and local traditions. But there is hope for the next generations.

programme.title: Apollo 8 Christmas At The Moon
programme.desc: This one hour documentary profiles the first manned Mission to the Moon, and includes interviews with the astronauts and many of the NASA officials who were a part of this historic event.

programme.title: Origin of the Species
programme.desc: Abigail Child has been at the vanguard of experimental media since the 1980s. In her latest project, she offers viewers an eerie look into the present and future of AI, through the perspectives of scientists, entrepreneurs and a Black lesbian robot. Child’s thought-provoking film considers the emerging technology’s ethical and emotional implications, presenting a speculative, not-too-distant future grounded in sci-fi.

programme.title: The Neutral Ground
programme.desc: In 2015, CJ Hunt was filming the New Orleans City Council’s vote to remove four confederate monuments from the city. A forceful group of critics protested the decision and fearing retaliation, no crew would agree to remove the statues. CJ sets out to understand why a losing army from 1865 still holds so much power in America. At once funny and furious, this film documents the USA's troubled romance with the Lost Cause.

As the program begins he finds himself in a graveyard, where he is visited by an important insight ... "being dead sucks!" Later in the program, he meets the president of Canada's Freethought Association, which stirs up a little controversy with it's provocative ad slogan "There's probably no God. So stop worrying and enjoy life". Finally, he finds himself immersed in God.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

programme.title: War Peace
programme.desc: War/Peace documentary film is re-introducing the radical student activists from the late 60s. Ex-leaders of The Weather Underground movement Bill Ayers and Bernardine Dohrn. For decades the government and press have tried their best to silence them. This film will serve as an historical reminder of what happened the last time a group of young minds planned to take over an unpopular government in Washington.

programme.title: The Great Awakening: QAnon
programme.desc: The far-right political movement known as QAnon has taken off around the world, mobilising a committed band of believers dedicated to fighting what they claim is an ‘online war’ against corrupt, child abusing elites. In the United States, the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has declared QAnon a potential domestic terrorism threat. For one family, QAnon has caused division so severe that they had to report their relative - Tim Stewart, a QAnon conspiracy theorist - to Australia's national security hotline. In a concerning twist, it emerged that Stewart has had a longstanding friendship with Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison - leading to speculation about QAnon and Australia's highest ranks of political power. A look at the alarming movement which has caused ripples through the world, through the eyes of one family.

programme.title: Unknown Distance
programme.desc: After five tours and ten years as a Marine Sniper, Sergeant Douglas Brown, alongside director and producer Gordon Clark, takes us on an emotional journey across America, documenting the powerful testimony of returning combat veterans - all trained with a deadly skill set, now rendered useless. How do these soldiers fit back into a society that supported them when they enlisted but became ambivalent when they returned?

programme.title: Mariupol: The Chronicles of Hell
programme.desc: Mariupol - ruined but not conquered. The city in the east of Ukraine has survived the occupation, total destruction, and a humanitarian catastrophe. The story of Mariupol is an especially horrifying one, with accounts reported that occupiers were murdering civilians, and actively preventing them from escaping. This film is the story of the survivors, and their life in a hell on Earth. Yet it's also a testament to the power of resilience, and Ukrainian fighting spirit.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: While many mainline Christian churches are in decline, Evangelical Christianity remains a powerful force in the 21st century. With 2.1 billion followers worldwide, this particular branch of faith must be doing something right. In this program, host Tevya enters the world of Evangelicals, meeting a local pastor whose weekly service is broadcast to five different locations and features a full rockband. He learns that it is all about giving back.

programme.title: Cosmic
programme.desc: In the wake of COVID19, students, doctors, and engineers from all around BC, Canada, formed an Open Source community to design innovative PPE devices and limit the spread of the virus.

programme.title: Outbreak Onboard
programme.desc: Cruise ships gave coronavirus a free ride around the world this Spring. While infected passengers think the Ruby Princess should be sailed out to sea and sunk, its owner company is busy marketing post-Covid cruises. Far from protecting people, the release of the ship’s passengers onto Australian shores triggered a public health emergency with the Ruby Princess now named as the single largest source of Australia’s coronavirus infections. Tracey Temple, a passenger with underlying health conditions, is adamant that Princess Cruises forewent their duty of care. “As far as I’m concerned, they never put our safety first”. Pleas for information were met with reassurance from staff that “this ship is virus free”. The cruise liner was ultimately called back to Sydney, but not before the virus had spread unchecked among the passengers, and unchallenged by social distancing measures. Unaware of the public health disaster they were carrying, the passengers then dissipated not only across Australia, but the world. “We thought we were going into the problem; we didn’t realise we were the problem,” says another passenger. 850 passengers and crew from the ship contracted the virus,and at least 26 died.

programme.title: Finding Freedom
programme.desc: Finding Freedom is a feature length documentary that explores rehabilitation through the stories of Franklin and Malcolm, who after being released from South Africa’s notorious prison system, work to redefine the freedom that comes with life after a life sentence.

programme.title: Good old Czechs
programme.desc: During World War Two, Czechoslovakian airmen fought across the world. Defending the Allied Power's skies, they even played an integral role in the Battle of Britain. This is the story of two Czech men who served in Britain's RAF - yet on return to their home country, a hero's welcome merges into persecution, as the communist party seizes power. A timeless and poignant recounting of young lives sacrificed in wartime.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient
programme.desc: El viaje de hoy en busca de más milagros de la naturaleza nos lleva a la región de los lagos de Masuria, un impresionante mundo acuático en el noreste de Polonia. A continuación cambiaremos la fría región del Báltico por el Caribe tropical. Aquí demostraremos que sería un error relacionar la provincia cubana de Guantánamo únicamente con la famosa base naval estadounidense. Para terminar, volveremos a la región mediterránea de Europa para visitar a los habitantes de las islas Lípari, que siguen sobreviviendo a la sombra de volcanes siempre humeantes.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient

programme.desc: In this episode we visit places where people haven’t had it easy. Despite the hardships they experience daily, they choose to stay and shape their destiny. programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E12 - Naturally Refreshing
programme.desc: Tailandia es uno de los pocos países del sudeste asiático que nunca ha sido colonia europea. Quizá la palabra "thai", que significa "libre", tenga algo que ver con ello. Posiblemente sea la razón por la que este país evoca cierta magia que lo diferencia de los países de su entorno. De Tailandia viajamos a Sri Lanka.

programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E13 - The Best Of

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E05 - Alaska Caribou Part 2
programme.desc: En las profundidades del territorio de Alaska, Laramy caza caribúes hasta que un grave accidente con el Hawken pone en entredicho toda la cacería.
programme.sub-title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E05 - Alaska Caribou Part 2

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E06 - Montana Elk
programme.desc: ¿Podrá Laramy sobrevivir a las duras condiciones del territorio de los alces? Con un fallo de encendido y un nuevo manto de nieve sobre las montañas, la tarea de capturar un alce para el invierno se hace cada vez más difícil.
programme.sub-title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E06 - Montana Elk

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E07 - Blacksmith Show
programme.desc: Forjar sus propias herramientas era una valiosa habilidad para los montañeses. Laramy nos muestra cómo fabrica su propio equipo.
programme.sub-title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E07 - Blacksmith Show

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E08 - Idaho Elk
programme.desc: Con una etiqueta en el bolsillo, Laramy se lanza a las montañas de Idaho a la caza del esquivo alce.
programme.sub-title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E08 - Idaho Elk

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline
programme.desc: Desde salvadores de rinocerontes e investigadores de leones, hasta empresarios astutos y equipos de seguridad armados, Iván recorre la primera línea de la conservación para conocer a las personas que están remodelando y protegiendo el África salvaje. ¿Qué significa realmente dedicar la vida a la causa de la conservación? Ivan viaja a cuatro países distintos para averiguar qué mueve a estos héroes anónimos.
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E13 - Who is the King?
programme.desc: Se calcula que hay aproximadamente 8,7 millones de especies diferentes de animales en la Tierra. Cada una de ellas ha desarrollado técnicas y habilidades de supervivencia únicas, específicas y a menudo mortales. ¿Cómo elegir un favorito entre un abanico tan amplio de criaturas espectaculares y hermosas?
programme.sub-title: Wild Ones - S01:E13 - Who is the King?

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E01 - The Hills Have Fangs
programme.desc: Armado sólo con su ingenio, las herramientas y dispositivos más rudimentarios y cero armadura, el experto en depredadores Manny Puig te guiará por algunas de las aguas más turbias y los lugares más peligrosos del planeta. En este episodio, Manny Puig explora las cordilleras costeras del sur de California en busca de la supertóxica serpiente de cascabel del Pacífico Sur.
programme.sub-title: Savage Wild - S02:E01 - The Hills Have Fangs

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E02 - Blue Water Savages Part 1
programme.desc: A 60 millas de la costa, rodeado de múltiples marrajos y tintoreras, Manny Puig tiene los encuentros con tiburones más emocionantes de su vida.
programme.sub-title: Savage Wild - S02:E02 - Blue Water Savages Part 1

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E03 - Blue Water Savages Part 2
programme.desc: A 60 millas de la costa, rodeado de múltiples marrajos y tintoreras, Manny Puig tiene los encuentros con tiburones más emocionantes de su vida.
programme.sub-title: Savage Wild - S02:E03 - Blue Water Savages Part 2

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient
programme.desc: El viaje de hoy en busca de más milagros de la naturaleza nos lleva a la región de los lagos de Masuria, un impresionante mundo acuático en el noreste de Polonia. A continuación cambiaremos la fría región del Báltico por el Caribe tropical. Aquí demostraremos que sería un error relacionar la provincia cubana de Guantánamo únicamente con la famosa base naval estadounidense. Para terminar, volveremos a la región mediterránea de Europa para visitar a los habitantes de las islas Lípari, que siguen sobreviviendo a la sombra de volcanes siempre humeantes.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E11 - Naturally Distinctive
programme.desc: In this episode we visit places where people haven’t had it easy. Despite the hardships they experience daily, they choose to stay and shape their destiny. Bamiyan – a poverty stricken Afghan province, mercilessly tested by time. Niğde – a Turkish province with striking history. And Patagonia – the rough land at the very end of the world.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E11 - Naturally Distinctive

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E12 - Naturally Refreshing
programme.desc: Tailandia es uno de los pocos países del sudeste asiático que nunca ha sido colonia europea. Quizá la palabra "thai", que significa "libre", tenga algo que ver con ello. Posiblemente sea la razón por la que este país evoca cierta magia que lo diferencia de los países de su entorno. De Tailandia viajamos a Sri Lanka.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E12 - Naturally Refreshing

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E08 - Naturally Harmonious
programme.desc: Zambia, la región letona de Kurzeme, las provincias georgianas de Kakheti y Svaneti, parecen tener muy poco en común. Se encuentran en África, Europa y en la frontera entre Europa y Asia, respectivamente. Kakheti y Svaneti forman parte de Georgia, pero son muy diferentes entre sí. Entonces, ¿dónde está la conexión? ¿En qué se parecen estas regiones?

Se encuentran en África, Europa y en la frontera entre Europa y Asia, respectivamente. Kakheti y Svaneti forman parte de Georgia, pero son muy diferentes entre sí. Entonces, ¿dónde está la conexión? ¿En qué se parecen estas regiones?
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E08 - Naturally Harmonious

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy
programme.desc: 反思戴安娜公主的遺產，這個節目深入探討了她在突然去世後留下的遺產——她對孩子們、皇室以及愛她的人留下的印象。年輕的王子們在她的葬禮上因其舉止贏得了讚譽，但許多人質疑他們與查爾斯王子的關係未來將會如何發展。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E04 - Elizabeth At 80 Continuity And Change
programme.desc: Thanks to the Queen’s dedication, Britain found a way to move past its empire days and create a successful new identity, surprising many experts. This is the story of an amazing woman and her amazing life.
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E04 - Elizabeth At 80 Continuity And Change

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E11 - Operation Rogers Pass
programme.desc: 蒙大拿遊戲管理員布賴恩·戈利（Bryan Golie）幫助一名在森林中受傷的獵人。與此同時，其他管理員追踪一些試圖跳過檢查站的獵人，導致意想不到的結果。

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E05 - Rising Waters
programme.desc: Chris y Casey Keefer siguen avanzando río abajo, y a medida que se acerca la época de apareamiento de los alces, deben confiar más en pescar, cazar patos y recolectar bayas. Una enorme tormenta de lluvia de Alaska golpea, trayendo grandes desafíos para su éxito.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E06 - All Eyes On Us
programme.desc: Chris and Casey Keefer are back at it, catching fish for dinner and getting closer to being able to leave. But things get tense when a grizzly bear wanders too close to their campsite, putting both brothers in danger!
programme.sub-title: Dropped - S03:E06 - All Eyes On Us

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E07 - Naturally Fascinating

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E09 - Naturally Spiritual
programme.desc: En este episodio visitamos dos rincones diferentes de nuestro planeta. Aunque separados por miles de kilómetros, espiritualmente son parientes cercanos. En primer lugar, Etiopía, en África Oriental, diseccionada por el Gran Valle del Rift africano y considerada por muchos la cuna de la humanidad. A continuación, un paraíso en la Tierra: Jamaica.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient
programme.desc: El viaje de hoy en busca de más milagros de la naturaleza nos lleva a la región de los lagos de Masuria, un impresionante mundo acuático en el noreste de Polonia. A continuación cambiaremos la fría región del Báltico por el Caribe tropical. Aquí demostraremos que sería un error relacionar la provincia cubana de Guantánamo únicamente con la famosa base naval estadounidense. Para terminar, volveremos a la región mediterránea de Europa para visitar a los habitantes de las islas Lípari, que siguen sobreviviendo a la sombra de volcanes siempre humeantes.

programme.desc: Es un gran año para el campamento minero de Cripple River en Nome Alaska. El equipo está muy ocupado y los participantes ya están encontrando algunos de los mayores yacimientos de oro de la historia reciente.
programme.sub-title: Gold Fever - S20:E11 - Prospectors and Miners

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E12 - One Dredge: Tons of Gold
programme.desc: Tom lleva un par de años dragando un lugar en Arctic creek. Ahora es el momento en que él y Kia van a abrir el agujero con la esperanza de encontrar algo de oro en serio.
programme.sub-title: Gold Fever - S20:E12 - One Dredge: Tons of Gold

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E05 - Gang Wars
programme.desc: Ivan Carter investiga una operación de caza furtiva en el mercado negro africano.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E22 - Harry The Mysterious Prince
programme.desc: 儘管所有媒體的喧囂，其中許多並不算水準，哈里依然是一個謎。這部引人入勝的紀錄片提供了新視角和鏡頭，來揭示一位面對心痛和丑聞的皇室王子的故事。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E22 - Harry The Mysterious Prince

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E09 - Queen Camilla
programme.desc: 紀錄片《卡米拉女王？」更深入地探討了卡米拉·帕克·鮑爾斯，涵蓋了她的歷史、生活以及未來的方向。它集中於她與查爾斯王子的長期關係。該片還探討了卡米拉在查爾斯王子和戴安娜王妃婚姻中所扮演的角色的戲劇性。

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E12 - Operation Elk Dummy
programme.desc: 蒙大拿州的遊戲管理員在全州設置假麋鹿以試圖抓捕潛在的偷獵者。

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E07 - Salmon Island
programme.desc: Ahora que la mayor parte de las aves acuáticas se han dirigido más al sur para migrar, los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer están poniendo su esfuerzo en la pesca para obtener las calorías que necesitan. Están regresando río abajo después de empacar el campamento, enfocándose en un área que creen tiene varios alces.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E08 - Log Jammed
programme.desc: 當兄弟們接近一部分滿是駝鹿的河流時，他們面臨著一堆問題。他們必須找到繞過的方法，並把東西搬過一堆巨大的原木，這可能會破壞他們的獵遊，可能將他們推向一部分他們未準備好的河流。

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E09 - Naturally Spiritual
programme.desc: En este episodio visitamos dos rincones diferentes de nuestro planeta. Aunque separados por miles de kilómetros, espiritualmente son parientes cercanos. En primer lugar, Etiopía, en África Oriental, diseccionada por el Gran Valle del Rift africano y considerada por muchos la cuna de la humanidad. A continuación, un paraíso en la Tierra: Jamaica.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E09 - Naturally Spiritual

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient
programme.desc: El viaje de hoy en busca de más milagros de la naturaleza nos lleva a la región de los lagos de Masuria, un impresionante mundo acuático en el noreste de Polonia. A continuación cambiaremos la fría región del Báltico por el Caribe tropical. Aquí demostraremos que sería un error relacionar la provincia cubana de Guantánamo únicamente con la famosa base naval estadounidense. Para terminar, volveremos a la región mediterránea de Europa para visitar a los habitantes de las islas Lípari, que siguen sobreviviendo a la sombra de volcanes siempre humeantes.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E11 - Prospectors and Miners
programme.desc: Es un gran año para el campamento minero de Cripple River en Nome Alaska. El equipo está muy ocupado y los participantes ya están encontrando algunos de los mayores yacimientos de oro de la historia reciente.
programme.sub-title: Gold Fever - S20:E11 - Prospectors and Miners

programme.desc: 儘管所有媒體的喧囂，其中許多並不算水準，哈里依然是一個謎。這部引人入勝的紀錄片提供了新視角和鏡頭，來揭示一位面對心痛和丑聞的皇室王子的故事。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E22 - Harry The Mysterious Prince

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E01 - Empty Handed
programme.desc: En zonas remotas, la supervivencia es un juego cotidiano. Los anfitriones Chris y Casey Keefer se proponen sobrevivir 30 días en plena naturaleza. Cada nuevo día, estos hermanos enfrentarán sus habilidades como cazadores, leñadores y pescadores a un paisaje implacable y despiadado. DROPPED enfrenta a los espectadores a la dura realidad de que sólo se puede comer lo que se puede matar. Una auténtica prueba de supervivencia.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E02 - Long Days, Cold Nights
programme.desc: Los hermanos Keefer despiertan en una tundra helada. Con más de 8 millas por recorrer y sin remos, los hermanos se ven obligados a abrirse camino a través de aguas poco profundas y tierra estéril mientras se dirigen río abajo en busca de su segundo escondite.
programme.sub-title: Dropped - S05:E02 - Long Days, Cold Nights

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E03 - Choke Point
programme.desc: El terreno empieza a cambiar a medida que los hermanos Keefer se ven obligados a abrirse camino río abajo. El paisaje se estrecha y conduce a los hermanos a un punto geográfico donde se reúnen depredadores y presas.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E04 - Bone Weary
programme.desc: Los hermanos Keefer se refugian en un pequeño pinar mientras una tormenta invernal asedia el río. Obligados a esperar a que pase el temporal, los hermanos intentan conservar la poca energía que les queda.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E05 - Fireside Fortune
programme.desc: Utilizando sus últimas energías, los hermanos Keefer se dirigen río abajo en busca de su siguiente alijo. La marea cambia cuando finalmente logran salir de la tundra abierta y entrar en el corazón del territorio de los alces.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E11 - Road and Rail Disasters
programme.desc: Abróchese el cinturón y manténgase alerta...... Horas desesperadas analiza los accidentes de tráfico y ferroviarios, entre ellos el accidente ferroviario español de Santiago de Compostela, un accidente de carretera en Pakistán, el accidente de un camión petrolero en Nigeria en el que murieron 96 personas, el accidente ferroviario del Queen of the Sea en Sri Lanka, los accidentes provocados por la niebla en Italia y el Reino Unido, un accidente de cien vehículos en la autopista A1 en Austria, un accidente de carretera en México y un accidente de Amtrak en Estados Unidos.
programme.sub-title: Desperate Hours - S01:E11 - Road and Rail Disasters

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E12 - Environmental Disaster
programme.desc: Más vale prevenir que curar...... Horas desesperadas analiza el Protocolo de Kioto y el peligro de la subida del nivel del mar. El programa examina las causas de las catástrofes medioambientales, como los vertederos, la gran mancha de basura del Pacífico, los vertidos de petróleo, la contaminación atmosférica y la destrucción de la selva tropical, así como los efectos destructivos de las catástrofes medioambientales, como el agotamiento de la capa de ozono y el aumento de las temperaturas en el Ártico.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E13 - Desperate World
programme.desc: Horas desesperadas examina algunas de las peores catástrofes del mundo. Analiza la erupción del Eyjafjallajökull en Islandia, los terremotos de Nepal. epidemias como el ébola y el SARS, el incendio de la Zona de Nuevo Desarrollo de Binhai en China, el huracán Sandy en Nueva York, el tsunami del Océano Índico en el sudeste asiático, un destructivo sumidero en Bosnia, el desastre de la central nuclear de Fukushima, la catástrofe del gas de Bhopal, el accidente del Exxon Valdez en Alaska, y accidentes de tráfico y aéreos.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E01 - Lost!
programme.desc: Nick and Laura subject themselves to intense survival training with the Survival Training School of California deep in the mountains.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E02 - Sniper Science
programme.desc: Nick y Laura exploran la variedad de habilidades que utilizan los francotiradores militares: puntería, tiro a larga distancia, detección, acecho, camuflaje, infiltración, reconocimiento especial y adquisición de objetivos.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E05 - Fisherman's Catch
programme.desc: Bradley quiere ofrecer a un grupo de pescadores una cena inusual, algo totalmente inesperado. En el menú: caracoles de mar seguidos de un ambicioso plato de pepinos de mar y como plato principal un risotto de cangrejo Dungeness.
programme.sub-title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E05 - Fisherman's Catch

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E06 - Alutiq Anniversary
programme.desc: La familia Ewing organiza una cena para celebrar el 20 aniversario del Museo AlutIq. En el menú: buñuelos de almejas con algas, algas con mermelada de ruibarbo y arándanos, carne de caza con puré de patatas al rábano picante con setas, espárragos y puerros. El reto consiste en elaborar una cena memorable con ingredientes locales para los habitantes de Alutiq y presentarla de una forma que nunca antes hayan probado.
programme.sub-title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E06 - Alutiq Anniversary

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E07 - Bush Pilot's Birthday
programme.desc: El cumpleaños de un piloto de Bush garantiza un menú exquisito con gambas del Pacífico y pasta para empezar el menú de este episodio seguido de pechuga de pato con raíz de apio y como plato principal hay conejo y zanahorias.
programme.sub-title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E07 - Bush Pilot's Birthday

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E01 - Ken Henderson Story
programme.desc: Los mejores amigos, Ed Cohen y Ken Henderson, salen dos días a pescar en el golfo de Texas. La tragedia golpea y los dos hombres quedan varados a la deriva en aguas hostiles.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S01:E01 - Ken Henderson Story

programme.desc: Más vale prevenir que curar...... Horas desesperadas analiza el Protocolo de Kioto y el peligro de la subida del nivel del mar. El programa examina las causas de las catástrofes medioambientales, como los vertederos, la gran mancha de basura del Pacífico, los vertidos de petróleo, la contaminación atmosférica y la destrucción de la selva tropical, así como los efectos destructivos de las catástrofes medioambientales, como el agotamiento de la capa de ozono y el aumento de las temperaturas en el Ártico.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E13 - Desperate World
programme.desc: Horas desesperadas examina algunas de las peores catástrofes del mundo. Analiza la erupción del Eyjafjallajökull en Islandia, los terremotos de Nepal. epidemias como el ébola y el SARS, el incendio de la Zona de Nuevo Desarrollo de Binhai en China, el huracán Sandy en Nueva York, el tsunami del Océano Índico en el sudeste asiático, un destructivo sumidero en Bosnia, el desastre de la central nuclear de Fukushima, la catástrofe del gas de Bhopal, el accidente del Exxon Valdez en Alaska, y accidentes de tráfico y aéreos.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E01 - Lost!
programme.desc: Nick and Laura subject themselves to intense survival training with the Survival Training School of California deep in the mountains.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E02 - Sniper Science
programme.desc: Nick y Laura exploran la variedad de habilidades que utilizan los francotiradores militares: puntería, tiro a larga distancia, detección, acecho, camuflaje, infiltración, reconocimiento especial y adquisición de objetivos.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E05 - Fisherman's Catch
programme.desc: Bradley quiere ofrecer a un grupo de pescadores una cena inusual, algo totalmente inesperado. En el menú: caracoles de mar seguidos de un ambicioso plato de pepinos de mar y como plato principal un risotto de cangrejo Dungeness.
programme.sub-title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E05 - Fisherman's Catch

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E06 - Alutiq Anniversary
programme.desc: La familia Ewing organiza una cena para celebrar el 20 aniversario del Museo AlutIq. En el menú: buñuelos de almejas con algas, algas con mermelada de ruibarbo y arándanos, carne de caza con puré de patatas al rábano picante con setas, espárragos y puerros. El reto consiste en elaborar una cena memorable con ingredientes locales para los habitantes de Alutiq y presentarla de una forma que nunca antes hayan probado.
programme.sub-title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E06 - Alutiq Anniversary

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E07 - Bush Pilot's Birthday
programme.desc: El cumpleaños de un piloto de Bush garantiza un menú exquisito con gambas del Pacífico y pasta para empezar el menú de este episodio seguido de pechuga de pato con raíz de apio y como plato principal hay conejo y zanahorias.
programme.sub-title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E07 - Bush Pilot's Birthday

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E01 - Ken Henderson Story
programme.desc: Los mejores amigos, Ed Cohen y Ken Henderson, salen dos días a pescar en el golfo de Texas. La tragedia golpea y los dos hombres quedan varados a la deriva en aguas hostiles.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S01:E01 - Ken Henderson Story

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E12 - The New Royals
programme.desc: Princesses Beatrice and Eugenie have gone through a lot of media attention and tough situations in their lives. From their parents' very public split to being targeted by the press, they've been through quite a bit. Despite all this, they remain dedicated to supporting the monarchy with their charity work. Through serving the Commonwealth, both sisters continue to make a positive impact.
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E12 - The New Royals

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E13 - Operation Wolf Creek
programme.desc: 守望者在蒙大拿州沃爾夫溪周圍尋找任何非法狩獵。在另一個地方，他們設置了一個假騾鹿的誘餌，以抓住違規的獵人。

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E09 - Bull In The Bush
programme.desc: 經過三個多星期的徒步旅行後，兄弟克里斯和凱西·基弗終於在一個新地方扎營，幾乎立即與一頭巨大的公鹿面對面。
programme.sub-title: Dropped - S03:E09 - Bull In The Bush

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E10 - End Of The Line
programme.desc: 在不利的情況下，80英里的河流冒險幾乎結束，兄弟克里斯和凱西·基弗有最後一次機會在距離他們在河流交匯處被接走的地方幾英里之內找到阿拉斯加的駝鹿。
programme.sub-title: Dropped - S03:E10 - End Of The Line

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E11 - Naturally Distinctive
programme.desc: In this episode we visit places where people haven’t had it easy. Despite the hardships they experience daily, they choose to stay and shape their destiny. Bamiyan – a poverty stricken Afghan province, mercilessly tested by time. Niğde – a Turkish province with striking history. And Patagonia – the rough land at the very end of the world.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E11 - Naturally Distinctive

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E12 - Naturally Refreshing
programme.desc: Tailandia es uno de los pocos países del sudeste asiático que nunca ha sido colonia europea. Quizá la palabra "thai", que significa "libre", tenga algo que ver con ello. Posiblemente sea la razón por la que este país evoca cierta magia que lo diferencia de los países de su entorno. De Tailandia viajamos a Sri Lanka.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E12 - Naturally Refreshing

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E01 - The Golden Gauntlet
programme.desc: Kia reta a Tom a una competición, el que encuentre más oro con un depósito de gasolina gana - ¡el ganador se lo lleva todo! kwadventure
programme.sub-title: Gold Fever - S21:E01 - The Golden Gauntlet

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E02 - Omilak Silver Mine
programme.desc: Tom y Kia se adentran en helicóptero en la selva de Alaska para investigar una misteriosa mina de plata que les dejó el buitre.
programme.sub-title: Gold Fever - S21:E02 - Omilak Silver Mine

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E06 - The Zambezi River Mystery
programme.desc: Carter's W.A.R. (Wild Animal Response) es la historia jamás contada de la búsqueda de un hombre para salvar su tierra natal, el continente más salvaje y peligroso del mundo, África. Desde cazadores furtivos fuertemente armados que masacran elefantes por sus colmillos hasta la matanza de rinocerontes por sus cuernos, el recurso más preciado de África está en peligro. ¿Puede un hombre descubrir la verdad y cambiar las cosas? Vea cómo Ivan Carter, detective de la fauna salvaje y cazador profesional, le lleva al interior del África real, a la primera línea de las guerras que se libran contra su fauna salvaje.
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E06 - The Zambezi River Mystery

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: 當戴安娜訂婚時，她始終處於媒體的視野中。她在一生中專注於自己的兒子，並致力於慈善工作，例如對地雷發表意見。戴安娜利用自己的名氣來引起人們對這些和其他重要問題的關注。這部經過深思熟慮的節目更深入地研究了20世紀最驚人的人物之一。通過前所未見的畫面，它展示了她從一個害羞的少女走到成為威爾士公主戴安娜的歷程，包括她最後日子的感人時刻。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E01 - Operation Grizzly Bear
programme.desc: 這個星期，守望者正在處理一起涉及失蹤兒童的情況，據報導這名兒童被熊拉走……幸運的是，這只是一次訓練演習。同時，脫落角的狩獵季節開始了，使守望者忙碌不已！

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E01 - To Be Alive
programme.desc: Chris and Casey Keefer check out video entries to pick a lucky pair to come with them to Alaska. The hunters meet each other at the airport for the first time. Casey and Kaid get Dropped off, while Chris and the rest face delays at the hangar.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E02 - Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: El clima en Alaska mejora lo suficiente para que Chris y Kaid lleguen a su destino y atrapen algo de comida. Mientras tanto, Casey y R.L. ya han montado su campamento, preparándose para la temporada de alces. Los hermanos deberán acostumbrarse a la idea de ser dejados por separado por primera vez.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E01 - Rookie Pressure
programme.desc: Anthony se esfuerza por demostrar su valía como médico jefe al responder a un accidente de moto de nieve en Togwotee Pass.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E02 - Home Safe
programme.desc: La primera prioridad de cada misión es la seguridad del equipo, así que cuando las condiciones en Pyramid Peak amenazan a Jake y Cody durante un rescate, Tim exige que echen el freno.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E03 - Kia Under the Bering Sea
programme.desc: Kia draga en busca de oro en el fondo del mar de Bering.
programme.sub-title: Gold Fever - S21:E03 - Kia Under the Bering Sea

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E04 - Virtual Gold
programme.desc: Tom y Kia nos dan una vuelta por el campamento minero de Cripple River, y Tom decide buscar lo que él llama "oro virtual"... ¿usando restos de cohetes?

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E07 - Death for Profit
programme.desc: Ivan Carter se une a los héroes que salvan rinocerontes en el Parque Nacional Kruger de África
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E07 - Death for Profit

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E22 - Harry The Mysterious Prince

programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E22 - Harry The Mysterious Prince

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E03 - Predators Prowl
programme.desc: Chris and Kaid were getting their rafts set up, while Casey and R.L. started looking around for black bears and moose. Just then, Chris and Kaid noticed a predator making its way towards their campsite.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E04 - Cloudy Days
programme.desc: It's the second day of hunting season, and Chris and Kaid are still on the lookout for big game. They head downstream to see if they can find a better spot to catch some fish. Meanwhile, Casey and R.L. feast on salmon, getting some much-needed protein. Huge storm clouds are pouring over Alaska.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E03 - Married to the Job
programme.desc: Jake y Marilynn cancelan una cena para poder atender a un esquiador herido en Teton Pass.
programme.sub-title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E03 - Married to the Job

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E04 - Juggled Lives
programme.desc: La ajetreada agenda del Dr. AJ Wheeler le mantiene fuera de combate, pero su equipo lucha contra los fuertes vientos en el helicóptero para salvar a un conductor de motos de nieve con el fémur roto. Luego recibe otra llamada y el Dr. Wheeler está allí, intentando rescatar a un hombre que cae por un acantilado de 60 metros.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E05 - Prospectors
programme.desc: Tom y Kael Massie buscan indicios de oro, desde la recogida de muestras en antiguas minas hasta el senderismo por las montañas con detectores de metales.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E06 - Golden Glaciers and Danger

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E07 - Sold into Slavery
programme.desc: Ivan está investigando el comercio ilegal de carne de caza en Kinshasa, cuando se topa con tres crías de chimpancé cautivas que se venden en el mercado negro. Se planea un dramático rescate en el que los chimpancés son entregados sanos y salvos a un lugar dedicado a proporcionar un futuro mejor a todos los primates de África.
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E07 - Sold into Slavery

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E04 - The Rock Quarry
programme.desc: Explorando una mina inundada y abandonada por la noche, Manny Puig busca depredadores mientras intenta comprender este mundo aislado y salvaje.
programme.sub-title: Savage Wild - S02:E04 - The Rock Quarry

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E05 - Primal River
programme.desc: Manny explora un río primitivo en busca de encuentros peligrosos y no queda decepcionado.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E06 - Snakebite!
programme.desc: Manny es gravemente mordido por una gran serpiente de cascabel de diamante del oeste, mientras que la grabación de un episodio de Salvaje Salvaje en el sur de Texas.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S02:E07 - Black Bear Encounter
programme.desc: Manny Puig experimenta espeluznantes encuentros en plena noche con enormes osos negros de Florida. En Florida, los animales de los bosques del norte se encuentran cara a cara con los de los trópicos, y los osos de aquí se enfrentan a ellos.
programme.sub-title: Savage Wild - S02:E07 - Black Bear Encounter

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E01 - Alpine Ghosts
programme.desc: Mario takes on the unforgiving alpine mountains of the south island of New Zealand in a fallow deer hunt with his bow, and cooks an impressive venison pie dish.
programme.sub-title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E01 - Alpine Ghosts

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E02 - Deadly Outback
programme.desc: In the outback of Australia where everything is trying to kill you. It's monsoon season when no one attempts to roam around with salt water crocodiles lurking. Mario links up with a long time friend in search of a wild Buffalo.
programme.sub-title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E02 - Deadly Outback

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E03 - Up with the Gods - Himalayan Tahr
programme.desc: Mario teams up with good friend and precision rifle expert Bernard and heads into the high alpine mountains above New Zealand's rugged West Coast. Drawing on his Greek roots, Mario cooks a rustic Kleftiko dish in an earth oven.
programme.sub-title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E03 - Up with the Gods - Himalayan Tahr

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E04 - Outback Odyssey
programme.desc: In one of the harshest environments on the planet, Mario travels to the outback desert of Australia in search of feral camels that have been running rampant. What seemingly feels to be a a simple task quickly turns into one of the hardest and most unexpected challenges he has taken on. With a bow in hand and scorching heat he explores the great dividing range, in hope of harvesting one of these middle eastern based beasts.
programme.sub-title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E04 - Outback Odyssey

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E09 - Trapping Part 2
programme.desc: La caza con trampas en invierno requiere habilidades diferentes a las de la caza con trampas en primavera. Laramy saca todos los trucos para atrapar bichos.
programme.sub-title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E09 - Trapping Part 2

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E10 - Idaho Deer
programme.desc: Laramy caza la cola blanca de montaña en las empinadas subidas de Idaho. Cazar estas montañas a la antigua usanza supone un tremendo desafío.
programme.sub-title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E10 - Idaho Deer

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E11 - Hide and Tanning Show
programme.desc: Un verdadero hombre de campo utiliza cada parte de la presa, y Laramy nos muestra por qué el desollado y curtido es una parte tan importante de la vida del hombre de montaña.
programme.sub-title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E11 - Hide and Tanning Show

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E12 - The Hunt of a Mountain Man 2
programme.desc: Laramy nos muestra cómo cazaban a mediados del siglo XIX los Hombres de la Montaña, que necesitaban habilidades y técnicas de acecho poco comunes para sobrevivir durante el invierno. Los duros inviernos eran conocidos como la "Muerte Blanca" por los Hombres de las Montañas.
programme.sub-title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S05:E12 - The Hunt of a Mountain Man 2

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E01 - Koala
programme.desc: This series is a unique look at the early life and development of young animals, edited and narrated from the viewpoint of the animal's themselves. As children explore the wonders of animal life, their natural fascination will deepen into a true love and appreciation of animals. In the first episode we meet Koala.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E02 - Gazelle
programme.desc: We gazelles live on the Savannah in Africa. Mummy said, that the Savannah is a very dry place. My dad has big horns so he can fight to protect us because lions want to eat us. We must be careful even by the river because crocodiles are watching. We eat mainly dry grass and if its not too dry we don’t need to drink much.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E03 - Sea Lion
programme.desc: We live in the ocean! It’s huge and wet. But mainly we live on the ocean shore. That’s where all the seal families make their home. What we love the most is swimming! Water is the greatest fun in the world. We have no problem staying in the water for hours at a time. Together with dolphins, we love to jump into the waves. Look at us go! Isn’t that awesome?
programme.sub-title: My Animal Friends - S01:E03 - Sea Lion

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E04 - Brumby
programme.desc: I am a wild horse who lives in Australia. We were born to run and the difference between me and a farm horse is that I can run freely where I want. I meet with my friends the donkeys and lizards at waterholes which are very precious for us. But watch out! We don’t like to be pushed around or feel threatened.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E05 - Butterfly
programme.desc: We Monarch Butterflies have to chew our way from our egg to see the world. Bite by bite together, with my brothers and sisters we start to feed on the leaves. We don’t have any parents but just know what to do. When we feel cold, hungry, or afraid, we feel the same way as you do. We travel a lot and are capable of eating much more than our own weight. Our life is definitely hard work.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E06 - Pelican
programme.desc: There are many pelicans in the world. We are Australian pelicans. But we don’t live only in Australia. We also live in other parts of the world. Pelicans like to hunt together. We hunt as a team. We swim in the water in a flock making noise with our feet and wings, that's how we drive the fish into shallows where we easily catch them. Flying is very easy for us and our nests are built from grass stems.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E07 - Elephant
programme.desc: Unsere Heimat ist Afrika und wir haben auch Verwandte in Indien. Aber das hier ist Afrika. Wir haben viele Freunde, die hier mit uns leben. Seht ihr? Gazellen, Antilopen, Gnus....sie alle fressen nur, was aus dem Boden wächst. Elefanten lieben es, im Wasser und im Schlamm zu spielen. Wir werfen den Schlamm umher und spritzen uns das Wasser über den ganzen Körper. Aber pass auf! Wir wollen nicht auf die Löwen treffen.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E08 - Tern
programme.desc: We live by the water and build our nests in the sand on the shores. We like to live all together in a flock. We terns are able to fly soooooooo long above the ocean without landing. If we don’t need to, we might not land at all. Flying is a blast! There are lots of different subspecies of tern. And we’re going to visit some of them today. We are all related. It’s kind of like being in a big family.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E09 - Ants
programme.desc: I’m a Green Tree Ant and I mainly live in the forests of Australia. We ants are incredibly strong, built for working hard and long. We must all work within the community to survive. We don’t do anything just for fun and we always think about all the other ants and what is good for us all. We have to fight together for our place in the forest and to protect the most important ant in our community which is our queen.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E10 - Sea Horse
programme.desc: In the seahorse family, it is the daddy who gives birth to us. He carry’s us in his sac, until we hatch from the eggs our mommy lay into his sac. There are various species of seahorse. That’s why we come in different sizes and shapes. Some live bound to the corals, because the marine currents are very strong. We love exploring the waters we live in.
programme.sub-title: My Animal Friends - S01:E10 - Sea Horse

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E11 - Bear
programme.desc: We bears live a solitary life but when it comes to hunting we take it as a reunion. We love to catch and eat fish in the river where we spend a lot of our time but the forest is also our home. We have a lot of animal neighbours such as buffalos, seagulls, coyotes but we never really like to meet with wolves. Everyone is a bit different, because everyone lives differently. That’s why it is better not mingle with others and stay with your own kind.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E12 - Budgie
programme.desc: We budgies live in Australia. Here you’ll find everything that budgerigars need: open and broad plains; lakes; rivers; and mainly thousands and thousands of budgerigar friends. I don’t know, but it’s a beautiful life. I like it. Eating grass seeds and chatting with our other beautiful friends makes me happy.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E13 - Cat
programme.desc: Wild cats and domestic cats are all born the same way but their way of life is a bit different. Wild cats eat what they catch. But domestic cats get food from humans. Domestic cats don’t have to hunt anymore. This wild cat lives all alone. She must find some hideout against bad weather and predators without any help. Domestic cats like the presence of human and a comfortable home. What is better?

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E39 - A Century Of The Queen Mother 100 Years In 100 Minutes
programme.desc: 100 years in 100 minutes
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E39 - A Century Of The Queen Mother 100 Years In 100 Minutes

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E05 - Butterfly
programme.desc: We Monarch Butterflies have to chew our way from our egg to see the world. Bite by bite together, with my brothers and sisters we start to feed on the leaves. We don’t have any parents but just know what to do. When we feel cold, hungry, or afraid, we feel the same way as you do. We travel a lot and are capable of eating much more than our own weight. Our life is definitely hard work.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E06 - Pelican
programme.desc: There are many pelicans in the world. We are Australian pelicans. But we don’t live only in Australia. We also live in other parts of the world. Pelicans like to hunt together. We hunt as a team. We swim in the water in a flock making noise with our feet and wings, that's how we drive the fish into shallows where we easily catch them. Flying is very easy for us and our nests are built from grass stems.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E07 - Elephant
programme.desc: Unsere Heimat ist Afrika und wir haben auch Verwandte in Indien. Aber das hier ist Afrika. Wir haben viele Freunde, die hier mit uns leben. Seht ihr? Gazellen, Antilopen, Gnus....sie alle fressen nur, was aus dem Boden wächst. Elefanten lieben es, im Wasser und im Schlamm zu spielen. Wir werfen den Schlamm umher und spritzen uns das Wasser über den ganzen Körper. Aber pass auf! Wir wollen nicht auf die Löwen treffen.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E08 - Tern
programme.desc: We live by the water and build our nests in the sand on the shores. We like to live all together in a flock. We terns are able to fly soooooooo long above the ocean without landing. If we don’t need to, we might not land at all. Flying is a blast! There are lots of different subspecies of tern. And we’re going to visit some of them today. We are all related. It’s kind of like being in a big family.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E09 - Ants
programme.desc: I’m a Green Tree Ant and I mainly live in the forests of Australia. We ants are incredibly strong, built for working hard and long. We must all work within the community to survive. We don’t do anything just for fun and we always think about all the other ants and what is good for us all. We have to fight together for our place in the forest and to protect the most important ant in our community which is our queen.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E10 - Sea Horse
programme.desc: In the seahorse family, it is the daddy who gives birth to us. He carry’s us in his sac, until we hatch from the eggs our mommy lay into his sac. There are various species of seahorse. That’s why we come in different sizes and shapes. Some live bound to the corals, because the marine currents are very strong. We love exploring the waters we live in.
programme.sub-title: My Animal Friends - S01:E10 - Sea Horse

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E11 - Bear
programme.desc: We bears live a solitary life but when it comes to hunting we take it as a reunion. We love to catch and eat fish in the river where we spend a lot of our time but the forest is also our home. We have a lot of animal neighbours such as buffalos, seagulls, coyotes but we never really like to meet with wolves. Everyone is a bit different, because everyone lives differently. That’s why it is better not mingle with others and stay with your own kind.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E12 - Budgie
programme.desc: We budgies live in Australia. Here you’ll find everything that budgerigars need: open and broad plains; lakes; rivers; and mainly thousands and thousands of budgerigar friends. I don’t know, but it’s a beautiful life. I like it. Eating grass seeds and chatting with our other beautiful friends makes me happy.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E13 - Cat
programme.desc: Wild cats and domestic cats are all born the same way but their way of life is a bit different. Wild cats eat what they catch. But domestic cats get food from humans. Domestic cats don’t have to hunt anymore. This wild cat lives all alone. She must find some hideout against bad weather and predators without any help. Domestic cats like the presence of human and a comfortable home. What is better?

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E39 - A Century Of The Queen Mother 100 Years In 100 Minutes
programme.desc: 100 years in 100 minutes
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E39 - A Century Of The Queen Mother 100 Years In 100 Minutes

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E03 - Sea Lion

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E14 - Dingo
programme.desc: Hello, I’m little dingo and my mummy will tell me the story of how I was born and how I live. Here we go - Once upon a time, in a country far, far away, called Australia......a huge and mysterious bird brought the soul of a little dingo down to the Earth......into his mummy’s tummy... and how did it continue? Listen to the whole story.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E15 - Clownfish
programme.desc: I love swimming around and playing in the waters of our tropical ocean. There is so much to explore and many colours and shapes. We live in the Sea Anemone and have a glossy coat. The Clown Fish has only three stripes on an orange body but some of our relatives have lots of stripes. Sometimes I like to look at the other fish but I think that the striped ones are the prettiest.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E16 - Cheetah
programme.desc: We are the fastest runners in the world. We hunt our dinner and when we do we can run only for a short distance, we must catch something fast; otherwise we have to stop. If we don’t stop we can overheat, and that’s a very dangerous condition for us. We also have an extra claw called an dew claw. When we’re chasing down a prey, we hook this claw around their legs to topple them over. We can do this running at our top speed. Cheetahs are recognizable by our black spots and they sure do suit us.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E17 - Crocodile
programme.desc: I am an alligator. No, not a crocodile - an alligator. When I got out of my egg I found myself in Australia which is the place where some of the biggest crocodiles in the world live. But they also live in other parts of the world too. And why are people afraid of crocodiles? Find out for yourself.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E18 - Echidna
programme.desc: Hello - I'm an echidna - some people call us spiny anteaters. When I was born I came out of my Mum's pouch. No, my spines didn't hurt her because I hatched from an egg and she kept me warm inside her pouch until I was ready to come out. It takes many days and nights, but a little echidna doesn’t really notice the time passing, because it’s hidden away. Whilst waiting Mum will dig a nursery den in the ground, into which she’ll put her growing baby and once the baby is fully developed it can go explore the world. Adventures await!

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E19 - Kangaroo
programme.desc: We love our home in Australia. We love all types of grass, but there are some types we prefer more. Oh did I mention we love to jump? Every part of a kangaroo’s body is perfectly suited for skillful jumping. What is also special about us is that when we are small our mom carries us in her pouch isn’t that cool?

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E20 - Kestrel
programme.desc: Hello! I’m a kestrel and I’ve a got a great view from our nest. My mummy is flying around here, somewhere. Kestrels are predators, which mean we eat meat. But we only hunt for things that are smaller than us – like voles, mice, and even some insects. We settle in hollow trees or something similar and lay our eggs. From that point, it takes less than a month for us little kestrels to hatch.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E21 - Turtle
programme.desc: Turtle Mum usually just lays her eggs and leaves. Once we hatch, we have to take care of ourselves. From the moment we hatch, we know everything we need to know. We know what to do, where the ocean is, how to swim, and how to walk. Our goal is to get into the water. In the ocean, we are agile, and great swimmers. We’re better at swimming than crawling around on land.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E22 - Zebra
programme.desc: Hello I’m a little zebra. You say you already know about me? I live in Africa. It’s nice and warm here, I like it a lot. Also, other animals live here with us and there is always something exciting going on. We are black and white and have stripes. When we come to waterholes we must be careful not to meet the crocodile because he would want to eat us. Even when there are a lot of us, we still walk together. We love to roll in the dust!

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E23 - My Friends From the Air
programme.desc: There are many birds in the world. You can hear their chattering, singing, cawing, and cackling across every continent. Do you think they will ever learn how to sing properly? And there are so many! Why don’t they ever crash? Lets learn more about our bird friends!
programme.sub-title: My Animal Friends - S01:E23 - My Friends From the Air

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E24 - My Friends From Water
programme.desc: Take a deep breath and let’s go under water. There are so many things and creatures to explore. There are all sorts of shapes and colours, and different ways of life. Each living thing: Humans and animals on dry land, fish living in water, birds, plants, and even insects - are all different. But most of us have three things in common: we breathe oxygen, eat, and breed. Let's look at some of our water animal friends.
programme.sub-title: My Animal Friends - S01:E24 - My Friends From Water

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E25 - My Friends From Savannah
programme.desc: A new day has begun on the savannah. Herds of gazelle, antelope, zebra, and all kinds of other animals move around to find fresh areas to graze. There are many species of animals living in Africa. They live on the seemingly endless plains of the savannah. Many animals you know from the zoo, live here in the wild. These wild animals like their freedom. They don’t need us to take care of them. They live freely in the wilderness.
programme.sub-title: My Animal Friends - S01:E25 - My Friends From Savannah

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E26 - My Best Friends
programme.desc: Today we will remind everyone of what we’ve learned in all the previous episodes, about the different lives of our animal friends. They are all here. The koala, turtle, cheetah, crocodile, bear, zebra and the butterfly...what do you remember about them?
programme.sub-title: My Animal Friends - S01:E26 - My Best Friends
